notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence. Wreck dates not given in the snippets read (years omitted deliberately; fiscal-year volume labels uncertain). Keeper roster is Lighthouse Friends only; the Marine Branch keeper tables (fiscal 1910 p.261, 1911 p.241) list Cape Dogs but columns were not matched. Exact first-lit date not found; the fiscal 1910 report records the new light. Quebec register gives 2014 municipal citation; routedesphares.qc.ca lists manager as 'Privé' which conflicts with Coast Guard ownership (not used). Wrecks' year labels: Romera in a report published 1917, Lycaon 1920, Rockferry 1921 volumes. Cap de la Tête au Chien called Cape Dogs in English reports.
